# FLX-2107: no recorded plan at this run id

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

`fluxsim apply --run-id <id>` (or `fluxsim verify`/`fluxsim ship` against that id) found no `plan.json` under `<state_dir>/runs/<id>/` -- the run id was never planned in this state directory, or the state directory is not the one `fluxsim plan` wrote into. Run `fluxsim plan` first, or omit `--run-id` to let `apply` plan implicitly.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2107
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
